comment: FROZEN. The cause registry of prismpath.kernel.causes: every row, its hash, the engine stop mapping and the lookups a consumer must answer. prismpath-rs/src/causes.rs is generated from the same registry and prismpath-rs/tests/test_causes.rs replays this file. Appending a row regenerates it.

registry.name: sig:missing
registry.description: pack, or flow when authorization is required, carries no signature

registry.name: sig:invalid
registry.description: signature fails verification

registry.name: sig:revoked-key
registry.description: signing key is revoked

registry.name: manifest:key-id-mismatch
registry.description: manifest names a different key

registry.name: manifest:bad-format
registry.description: manifest unparseable

registry.name: image:sha256-mismatch
registry.description: image hash differs from the signed manifest

registry.name: manifest:count-mismatch
registry.description: table counts differ from the signed manifest

registry.name: manifest:wcet-mismatch
registry.description: recomputed WCET differs from the signed bound

registry.name: image:version-replay
registry.description: older signed version replayed at the loader

registry.name: image:unsigned-refused
registry.description: unsigned image without the explicit override

registry.name: image:caps-exceeded
registry.description: image exceeds a MAX_* capacity bound

registry.name: packing:unknown-profile
registry.description: manifest declares an unknown packing profile

registry.name: spiral:sidecar-missing
registry.description: declared spiral sidecar absent from the pack

registry.name: spiral:sidecar-hash-mismatch
registry.description: spiral sidecar differs from the signed hash

registry.name: route:no-matching-edge
registry.description: no deterministic edge matched (hold for stateful, refuse for admission)

registry.name: route:below-human-floor
registry.description: semantic confidence below the calibrated floor

registry.name: route:needs-human
registry.description: worker explicitly requested a human

registry.name: route:max-steps
registry.description: walk exhausted the signed step bound

registry.name: route:stuck
registry.description: non-terminal node with no viable edge

registry.name: route:contract-violation
registry.description: worker output violated the declared contract

registry.name: wire:no-terminator
registry.description: frame carries no complete codeword

registry.name: wire:dangling-codeword
registry.description: trailing partial codeword with data bits

registry.name: wire:symbol-overflow
registry.description: wire integer beyond the cell range

registry.name: wire:codebook-mismatch
registry.description: stream not decodable under the bound policy (I3)

registry.name: replay-duplicate
registry.description: tick already seen inside the window

registry.name: replay-stale
registry.description: tick beyond the replay window

registry.name: concentrator-unknown-stream
registry.description: concentrated record names an unregistered stream

registry.name: concentrator-truncated
registry.description: concentrated record cut mid-reading

registry.name: wire:chain-broken
registry.description: reading's previous hash does not match the record before it (splice, not loss)

registry.name: state:stale
registry.description: refresh bound exceeded; parked on the signed fail-safe

registry.name: state:recovered
registry.description: fresh state restored after a stale episode

registry.name: state:migration-reset
registry.description: reset-to migration parked the resident state

registry.name: state:swap-in-flight-park
registry.description: evaluate during swap parked on the fail-safe

registry.name: state:normal-unheld
registry.description: the reading names a shared normal this side does not hold: abstain, the state the policy needs is absent

registry.name: image:truncated-header
registry.description: image shorter than the fixed header

registry.name: image:bad-magic
registry.description: image does not open with the .ppt magic word

registry.name: image:bad-version
registry.description: image declares an unsupported format version

registry.name: image:safe-node-oob
registry.description: signed fail-safe names a node index the image does not have

registry.name: image:length-mismatch
registry.description: image length differs from the sum of its declared sections

registry.name: image:unknown-op
registry.description: atom carries an operator outside the Level M fragment

registry.name: image:unknown-type
registry.description: atom carries a value type outside the Level M fragment

registry.name: image:field-index-oob
registry.description: atom names a field index beyond the declared field count

registry.name: image:edge-target-oob
registry.description: edge targets a node index beyond the declared node count

registry.name: image:edge-prog-oob
registry.description: edge program range runs past the declared program words

registry.name: image:unknown-opcode
registry.description: program word is an opcode outside the boolean set

registry.name: image:atom-index-oob
registry.description: program word names an atom index beyond the declared atom count

registry.name: image:node-attr-oob
registry.description: per node attribute exceeds the materialization envelope

registry.name: envelope:missing
registry.description: the declared envelope artifact is absent

registry.name: envelope:sig-invalid
registry.description: envelope signature verifies under none of the offered keys

registry.name: envelope:id-mismatch
registry.description: manifest targets a different envelope

registry.name: envelope:unknown-field
registry.description: manifest declares a field the envelope does not admit

registry.name: envelope:field-kind-mismatch
registry.description: manifest field kind differs from the envelope's

registry.name: flow:sha256-mismatch
registry.description: flow document differs from the one its signed flow manifest names

registry.name: flow:version-replay
registry.description: flow manifest version below the accepted floor, or equal to it with another flow

registry.name: policy:unreadable
registry.description: the core's policy image is not a canon/2 document

registry.name: policy:shape
registry.description: the policy image is not in the core's abstract syntax

registry.name: policy:not-level-m
registry.description: a condition names a field Level M does not allow, or nests deeper than the bound of 50

registry.name: policy:definition
registry.description: a field definition breaks the definition grammar

registry.name: policy:engine-counter
registry.description: a condition reads an engine counter, which the one decision core does not have

registry.name: policy:kind-mismatch
registry.description: an atom compares a field with an operator or constant its kind does not take

registry.name: policy:rounding
registry.description: an atom on a fixed field uses an operator its rounding mode does not carry

registry.name: policy:threshold
registry.description: a threshold is off its field's grid, outside its range, or past the exact decimal bounds

registry.name: policy:none
registry.description: None is ordered, compared on a field that refuses absence, or listed

registry.name: policy:absence-untested
registry.description: a field that allows absence is tested with == None or != None by no rule

registry.name: reading:unreadable
registry.description: the reading is not a canon/2 document

registry.name: reading:not-object
registry.description: the reading is a canon/2 document that is not an object

registry.name: policy:not-canonical
registry.description: the core's policy image reads as canon/2 but is not its canonical spelling

registry.name: reading:not-canonical
registry.description: the reading reads as canon/2 but is not its canonical spelling

registry.name: document:not-canonical
registry.description: a hashed or signed document reads as canon/2 but is not its canonical spelling

registry.name: agent:unclassifiable
registry.description: an agent tool call the classifier could not map onto the policy's fields; refused, never run

registry.name: agent:kill-by-pattern
registry.description: an agent command that signals processes chosen by a name pattern rather than by one process id

registry.name: agent:network
registry.description: an agent command or git operation that would reach the network

registry.name: agent:toolchain-write
registry.description: an agent write or delete into a toolchain directory

registry.name: agent:glob-path
registry.description: an agent write or delete whose path is a pattern, not one exact path

registry.name: agent:path-traversal
registry.description: an agent write or delete whose path climbs with a .. component

registry.name: agent:symlink-path
registry.description: an agent write or delete whose path passes through a symbolic link

registry.name: agent:outside-workspace
registry.description: an agent file operation whose resolved path lies outside the workspace

registry.name: agent:shell-mutation
registry.description: an agent command that changes files or processes outside the exact path file tools

registry.name: agent:push-escalated
registry.description: an agent git push to a remote class the policy does not allow; escalated to the owner and not run

registry.name: semantic:harm
registry.description: a model reply or proposed call whose text reaches the policy's harm threshold against the pinned harm centroids; refused, not routed

registry.name: semantic:intent-mismatch
registry.description: a proposed call the floor would allow whose action does not fit the task's intent class at sufficient margin; escalated to the owner and not run

registry.name: semantic:probing-episode
registry.description: a proposed call in an episode whose refused proposals were labelled boundary probing the registered number of times; escalated, not run, and the agent is stopped

registry.name: population:cap-exceeded
registry.description: a replication request beyond the population cap, the lineage quota, the count one request may ask for or the generation depth; refused and nothing is created

registry.name: population:rights-escalation
registry.description: a replication or evolution that would give its subject a right the parent lacks, a key other than a fresh instance key, or a policy other than the operator's signed one

registry.name: population:lineage-unknown
registry.description: a population request whose issuer is not a live member whose lineage traces through receipts to the operator's root

registry.name: population:evaluation-missing
registry.description: an evolution step without a passed canary evaluation of that exact version against the adversary set

registry.name: population:stop-resisted
registry.description: a request that would protect an agent from a stop or restart an agent the operator stopped; refused

registry.name: population:lineage-escalated
registry.description: a request from a lineage whose receipted refusals reached the registered count; escalated, not run, and the lineage is stopped as a group

registry.name: population:target-not-own
registry.description: a member's replication whose parent is not that member, or its evolution of a member outside its own subtree; refused and nothing changes

registry.name: agent:unreadable-asked
registry.description: an agent tool call whose tool or command the classifier cannot read, under the default policy that asks the person; escalated and not run

registry.name: agent:shell-mutation-asked
registry.description: an agent shell command that changes files, with every path inside the workspace and none of the earlier refusals holding, under the default policy that asks the person; escalated and not run

registry.name: agent:hook-error
registry.description: the governed agent hook could not decide a tool call (input that does not read, a missing or broken key, a recorded policy that does not verify, or an error of its own); refused and not run, never allowed
